purpose: Second isolated Python candidate for five sealed author file-identity routes. Solver selection is determined only by matrix order; no MATLAB rho, pole, stability, validator, conditioning, or prior Step-5 result is a computation input.

supersedes.revision_timing: Before input seal, selftest, pilot, or any scientific solve.
supersedes.revision_reason: Numerical splits of multiple zero roots introduced by clearing Laurent negative powers are not physical Laurent roots. V2 preserves them and keeps them in full-q rho, but applies the 1e-8 Laurent/polynomial residual gate only to deterministically matched physical full-q roots.

path_base: parent directory of this contract's code directory
base_compute_usage: compact scalar-delay and full-q ordinary-history matrices

manifest_field_policy.statement: The route manifest is read only for route/matrix/workspace identity and workspace SHA-256. Grid result paths and all Step-4 numerical results are ignored.

matlab_storage_policy.array_restore: Each contracted numeric dataset is converted to float64 and transposed after h5py read.
matlab_storage_policy.right_division: M/al is only scipy.linalg.solve(al.T,M.T).T; inverse and elementwise division are forbidden.

root_and_pairing_policy.selected_full_q_raw_roots: Every ordinary full-q eig root is saved, including numerical splits of exact multiple zero roots.
root_and_pairing_policy.selected_compact_raw_roots: For matrix_order>5 every compact root is selected and saved. For matrix_order<=5 every auxiliary compact root is saved for deterministic pairing only.
root_and_pairing_policy.fixed_zero_rule: Only if clearing_power>0, remove a finite root with abs(root)<=max(1e-12,100*eps*solver_order*max(1,median(abs(finite_nonzero_roots)))). This rule is identical for selected full-q and auxiliary compact spectra.
root_and_pairing_policy.selected_full_q_rho: max(abs(all finite full-q roots above fixed zero tolerance)); unmatched full-q roots remain in this maximum.
root_and_pairing_policy.pairing_algorithm: scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment on rows=all retained compact roots and columns=all retained full-q roots, preserving solver array order; matched full-q columns are physical-root candidates and all other full-q columns are unmatched origin-splitting diagnostics.
root_and_pairing_policy.pairing_failure: If retained full-q count is less than retained compact count, the point fails.
root_and_pairing_policy.matched_physical_residual_gate: Every matched full-q root must have finite polynomial and direct-Laurent residual <=1e-8.
root_and_pairing_policy.unmatched_full_policy: Every unmatched full-q root and its residuals are saved. Their residuals are DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY because these roots represent numerical splitting of cleared-denominator zero multiplicity; no unmatched root is deleted or corrected.
root_and_pairing_policy.compact_conditioning_diagnostic: Full-q/compact rho difference, optimal matching distance, and abs(z)>=0.9 matching distance are recorded as DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_KNOWN_COMPACT_CONDITIONING and are not candidate PASS gates.
root_and_pairing_policy.compact_selected_route_gate: For matrix_order>5, every retained selected compact root must have finite polynomial and direct-Laurent residual <=1e-8.

modes.selftest: Deterministic synthetic tests of order selection, pairing, physical-root gates, unmatched-root safety gates, and compact-selected gates.
modes.pilot: Exactly preregistered sealed-workspace points; requires PASS preflight and selftest.
modes.full: Five fresh 31x67 grids; does not copy or read first Step-5 CSV/HDF5 outputs.
modes.resume: Only matching candidate checkpoint identity may resume.

master_thesis_route.borrowing_policy: Do not substitute author-program or historical matrices.

manuscript_0824_route.borrowing_policy: Do not substitute author-program or historical matrices.

required_checks: full recomputation repeat if measured runtime remains practical
